slackware-13.0.name: Slackware 13.0 (Xfce 4.6, unattended, DVD script)

post_install_run: for i in $(seq 1 90); do pgrep -u {{user}} -x xfce4-session >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done; pgrep -u {{user}} -x xfce4-session >/dev/null && { set -- /var/log/packages/xfce4-session-*; [ -e "$1" ]; }

slackware-13.0.notes: Slackware 13.0 (August 2009): the first 64-bit release, kernel 2.6.29, Xfce 4.6 (the xfce package sits in xap, OPT), KDE 4.2, OpenSSH 5.2 (RSA key and the legacy SSH options). The install runs from the DVD's own shell: vmctl/slackware.py partitions, installpkg --root from the DVD (ADD and REC of the a/ap/l/n/x/xap series plus sudo and xfce, minus the screensavers and the big xap applications), configures the target, tty1 logs the user in (agetty -l) and ~/.bash_profile starts Xfce with startx; LILO on the MBR, the huge kernel. Born experimental: vmctl check-vms slackware-13.0 runs one.

slackware-14.2.notes: Slackware 14.2 (July 2016): kernel 4.4, OpenSSH 7.2 (the ed25519 key works), and KDE SC 4.14 (kde-workspace 4.11) from the kde series (186 ADD+REC packages; xinitrc.kde runs startkde, the check is the user's plasma-desktop).  The session needs sqlite (ksmserver) and flac, both in the ap series and tagged OPT, and the l series is installed whole (found live 2026-09-29). First live PASS 2026-09-29 (280 s, KDE 4.14 on tty1 autologin).

slackware-15.0.notes: Slackware 15.0 (February 2022): kernel 5.15, elogind, PAM, OpenSSH 8.8, and KDE Plasma 5.23 from the kde series (367 ADD+REC packages; xinitrc.kde runs startplasma-x11, the check is the user's plasmashell). The series shows three desktops: Xfce up to 14.1, KDE 4 on 14.2, Plasma on 15.0. Live PASS 2026-09-29 with Plasma (474 s, 1300 packages from the DVD, LILO, tty1 autologin; the Xfce recipe had passed the same day in 334 s). The session needs flac (plasma_session) and sqlite, both in the ap series and tagged OPT, and the l series is installed whole (found live 2026-09-29).
